toolDefinitions.name: bash
toolDefinitions.description: Run a shell script with bash in /workspace/home, the user's files (only what is saved there stays). Output is cut at 64 KiB. A call stops after timeoutSeconds (default 120, at most 1680). Network: curl, pip and git use the proxy, within the chat's network setting; a blocked host asks the user, do not get around it. To read or search web pages, prefer web_fetch or web_search if you have them.

toolDefinitions.name: status
toolDefinitions.description: Say whether this host can run commands in a sandbox now, and which backend runs them.

toolDefinitions.name: set-backend
toolDefinitions.description: Choose the backend that runs commands. Administrators only. The Settings page calls it; no model does.

toolDefinitions.name: confirm-host
toolDefinitions.description: Confirm that commands may run on this host without isolation, by typing the phrase. Administrators only. The Settings page calls it; no model does.

ui.description: Let your chats run commands and code in an isolated sandbox, with your files mounted.
ui.title: Sandbox
